common.synthetic: Synthetic preview data — not real people, horses or records.
common.notConnected: This part of Field Ops needs a build connected to the academy. Nothing here is real data.
common.denied: Your account can't see this. Ask your hub admin if you think it should.
common.notFound: This isn't at your hub, or it no longer exists.
common.offline: You're offline. Connect to load the latest information.
common.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again. Work saved in the app is kept.
common.error: This couldn't be loaded. Nothing was changed. Try again.
common.staleSince: No connection. Showing what was loaded at {{time}}.

horses.title: Horses
horses.denied: Horses are shown to hub staff only.
horses.empty: When the hub office adds horses, they appear here with today's care.
horses.careForAssigned: Care status is shown to the staff assigned to each horse. Proof waiting for a decision is in the review queue.
horses.searchEmpty: No horse at this hub matches “{{query}}”.

horse.notFound: This horse isn't at your hub.
horse.empty: No care tasks for {{horse}} are assigned to you from yesterday to tomorrow.

task.notFound: This task isn't among your assigned tasks.
task.notAssignedTitle: Care proof is sent by assigned staff
task.notAssigned: Your account doesn't send care proof. Proof waiting for a decision is in the review queue.
task.noInstructions: No instructions were entered for this task.
task.photoLive: Live camera only — no gallery uploads
task.notesUnavailable: Written notes can't be sent with care proof yet: the academy's care command has no notes field. Tell your hub admin anything important.
task.sendHint: Saves the proof and sends it when there is a connection
task.sendNeedsPhoto: Take the photo first. Location is optional; without it a supervisor reviews the proof.

sendError.no_session: Your session ended. Sign in again; nothing was saved.
sendError.storage_full: The phone is out of space. Free some space and try again.
sendError.capture_failed: The photo couldn't be read. Take it again.
sendError.not_allowed: This build can't keep proof on the phone.

phase.review: Received — a supervisor will review it

task.savedDurable: It is saved on this phone and sends when there is a connection.
task.savedMemory: It is kept only while the app is open. Keep the app open until it says Received.
task.sendingBody: Uploading the photo, then sending the record.
task.receivedBody: The academy has it. A supervisor still checks proof before the task counts as complete.
task.completedBody: A supervisor accepted the proof. Nothing else to do.
task.rejectedBody: A supervisor rejected the last proof. Take a new photo and send it again.
task.cancelledBody: The hub changed the schedule. This task no longer needs proof.
task.needsActionBody: It couldn't be sent. Open Sync to see why and what you can do.
task.resendBody: The academy already has proof for this task. A new photo is kept as extra evidence and a supervisor reviews it; it doesn't replace the first one.
task.leaveBody: The photo you took has not been saved or sent. Leaving discards it.

location.label: Location
location.off: Location is off for this app. The record goes to a supervisor.
location.notAsked: Allow location to add it as evidence. Without it a supervisor reviews the record.
location.failed: No location fix. Try again outside, or send without it for review.
location.weak: Weak signal ({{accuracy}}). A supervisor will review it.
location.purposeCare: The phone's location and its accuracy are saved with the proof photo, once, when you send it. They are not tracked in the background. Weak or missing location never blocks you; a supervisor reviews it.
location.purposeShift: The phone's location and its accuracy are saved once with your punch-in, as evidence. They are not tracked during the shift. A weak signal never blocks you; a supervisor reviews it.

shift.title: Shift
shift.heading: Your shift
shift.subtitle: Punch in when you start and out when you leave. The academy records its own time.
shift.denied: Punch-in is for grooms and instructors. Hub admins and family accounts don't punch in here.
shift.notInBody: Punch in when your shift starts.
shift.pendingDurable: Punch-in from {{time}} is saved on this phone. The academy records its own time when it arrives.
shift.pendingMemory: Punch-in from {{time}} is kept only while the app is open. Keep it open until it is sent.
shift.pendingStuck: The punch-in hasn't gone yet. Open Sync to see why.
shift.openBody: Recorded by the academy at {{time}} (phone time {{observed}}).

reason.lowAccuracy: The phone's location was not precise enough to place you within {{meters}} m of the hub.
reason.outsideRadius: The phone placed you more than {{meters}} m from the hub.
reason.noLocation: No location was sent, so a reviewer checks it. ({{meters}} m rule)
reason.hubUnknown: The hub's location isn't set, so distance can't be checked. ({{meters}} m rule)
reason.reviewAll: Every app punch-in is reviewed until the hub sets an accuracy rule. ({{meters}} m)
reason.aboveThreshold: Location accuracy was above the hub's {{meters}} m rule.

photo.not_supported: Not collected: the attendance command doesn't accept a photo yet (D11 pending).
photo.optional: Optional: a selfie goes to review with the punch-in.
photo.required: Required: a selfie goes to review with the punch-in.

shift.reviewAllBody: Every app punch-in is reviewed by a hub admin (no accuracy rule set).
shift.reviewThresholdBody: Reviewed unless you are within the hub area with accuracy of {{meters}} m or better.
shift.punchInHint: Works offline: it is sent when there is a connection, with the time you pressed it as evidence.
shift.punchOutHint: The academy records the time it receives your punch-out.
shift.punchOutOffline: Punch-out needs a connection: the academy records the time it receives it, so it can't be saved for later.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.heading: The academy didn't take this
conflict.gone: This item isn't waiting on this phone any more.
conflict.notConflict: This item isn't in conflict. Open Sync to see its state.
conflict.careGone: The task is no longer at the academy (the schedule changed or it was removed). Your photo is still on this phone.
conflict.careReused: The academy already used this item's reference for different content, so it refused it to avoid overwriting anything.
conflict.careHasProof: The academy already has proof for this task. Yours was not sent over it.
conflict.punchOpen: The academy already has an open punch-in for you. Punch out first, or keep the academy's record.
conflict.punchReused: The academy already used this punch-in's reference for a different punch, so it refused it.
conflict.unknown: The academy refused this and the reason isn't one this app can fix. Keep it for now or discard it.
conflict.answerConflict: Refused: it would clash with the record
conflict.noTask: The task isn't in your list any more
conflict.noOverwrite: Nothing here changes the academy's record. Choose what happens to your copy.

path.send_as_new: Send as extra proof for review

pathBody.send_as_new: Sends your copy as a separate record. The academy keeps both and a supervisor decides.
pathBody.keep_server: Deletes your copy from this phone after you confirm. It was never sent.
pathBody.open_shift: Punch out the open shift first; this item stays here meanwhile.
pathBody.later: Leaves it parked in Sync. It is never sent by itself.

conflict.blocked: The academy refused this because your account may no longer send it (access changed, not assigned, or another hub). It is not retried. It stays on this phone until you discard it.

review.title: Review queue
review.heading: To review at your hub
review.subtitle: Oldest first. Open an item to see its evidence and decide.
review.denied: Review is for the hub's reviewers. Your account isn't one at this hub.

empty.care_evidence: No care proof is waiting for a decision.
empty.shift_attendance: No punch-ins are waiting for a decision.
empty.rank_proposal: No rank proposals are waiting for a decision.

review.offlineDecisions: Decisions need a connection. Showing the list as last loaded.

reason.location_missing: No location was sent with it.
reason.outside_geofence: The location was outside the hub area.
reason.observed_in_future: The phone's clock was ahead of the academy's.
reason.task_already_completed: The task was already completed when this arrived.
reason.task_already_submitted: Proof for the task had already arrived.
reason.low_accuracy: Location accuracy was too weak to place them at the hub.
reason.outside_radius: The phone was outside the hub radius.
reason.review_all_policy: Every app punch-in is reviewed (no accuracy rule set).
reason.accuracy_above_threshold: Accuracy was above the hub's rule.
reason.rank_change: A rank change needs the configured approver.
reason.other: The academy flagged it for a person to check.
reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Required. 3 to {{max}} characters. It is kept with the decision.
reason.sheetBody: The staff member and the audit trail see this reason.
reason.serverRefused: The academy refused this reason. Check it and try again.

reviewItem.title: Review item
reviewItem.notFound: This item isn't at your hub any more.
reviewItem.photoSynthetic: Synthetic preview: there is no photo in preview data.
reviewItem.photoUnavailable: The photo can't be shown in this build.
reviewItem.noPhotoShift: No photo: punch-ins don't collect one yet
reviewItem.lateBody: Received after the due time and grace period
reviewItem.acceptNotVerified: Accepting records your decision. It does not mark the punch-in as verified presence.
reviewItem.ownRecord: This is your own record. Someone else at the hub reviews it.
reviewItem.cannotDecide: You can see this item but not decide it.
reviewItem.doneAt: The academy recorded your decision at {{time}}.
reviewItem.conflict: Another reviewer decided this item a moment earlier. Their decision is shown below; yours was not recorded.

rank.title: Rank proposal
rank.notFound: This cadet isn't at your hub.
rank.off: Who may propose and approve ranks hasn't been decided yet (D15), so ranks are changed by the academy outside the app.
rank.notProposer: Your role can't propose ranks under the current policy.
rank.authority: {{approver}} decides. Nobody can approve their own proposal, and no automatic thresholds are applied.
rank.noEvidence: A proposal must cite published assessments. Publish sessions first.
rank.noteHint: Up to {{max}} characters. The approver sees it.

problem.same_rank: Choose a rank different from the current one.

rank.conflict: An open proposal already exists for this cadet. It must be decided first.
rank.sent: {{name}} → {{rank}} was recorded at {{time}}. {{approver}} decides; the rank doesn't change until then.

posture.title: Posture review

reason.feature_disabled: The academy has switched this off while it is evaluated (D24).
reason.provider_not_configured: No analysis provider is set up for the academy.
reason.provider_not_integrated: A provider is named but not connected to the app yet.

posture.clipKept: Unchanged and private; open it from the assessment.
posture.gradingBody: Continues as normal. Scores are always yours.
posture.noResultBody: No landmarks, confidence or score is shown or made up.
posture.decisionBody: D24 / D34: any future suggestion is an instructor-reviewed overlay, never a score.

today.careNone: No care tasks for you today.
today.careNotAssigned: Care tasks appear for staff assigned to horses.
today.careOverdue: {{count}} overdue — proof not accepted 15 minutes after due
